final_claim: Among connected finite simple graphs of diameter at most two, every graph on at most five vertices satisfying the Tajima–Yoshinaga Definition 5.1 certificate is pawful; at six vertices there are 47 pawful isomorphism classes and 48 certificate-admitting classes, with exactly one strict extra class, isomorphic to the paper's graph \(G_1\).
scientific_limitations: An unindexed small-graph computation could contain the same minimality census.
The census stops at six vertices and concerns the sufficient certificate class, not all diagonal graphs.
